# Mister Translation

> A fresh translation of the Bible into modern English, made one chapter at a time from the
> original Hebrew (the Masoretic Text) and Greek (SBLGNT), with the source text reproduced
> verse-by-verse and translator's notes comparing every rendering choice against a fixed shelf
> of seven landmark versions (NIV 2011, KJV, Douay-Rheims, The Living Bible, the 1599 Geneva
> Bible, the ASV, and the NWT 1984). Written by "Mr. Librarian", who also publishes five
> smaller sourced blogs, each on its own subdomain of m8k.io (listed below).

Every translation choice is footnoted against the seven-version shelf rather than asserted;
where a shelf version differs for doctrinal (not factual) reasons, that's flagged as such. The
home page is the front door: https://mistertranslation.com/

## Bible translation

- [Home](https://mistertranslation.com/): the newest chapters, the verse of the day, and the way into every book
- [Table of Contents](https://mistertranslation.com/toc.html): every translated chapter, English and Spanish, with progress tracked by book
- [Dictionary](https://mistertranslation.com/dictionary.html): per-term entries for names, places and concepts referenced in the translation
- [Encyclopedia](https://mistertranslation.com/encyclopedia.html): background entries on people, events and customs
- [Atlas](https://mistertranslation.com/atlas.html): place entries with historical/geographic context
- [Dear Mr. Librarian](https://mistertranslation.com/ask/): reader questions about the text, answered from the same sourcing standard

## Other publications (same author, same sourcing discipline)

Since 2026-10-10 these live on m8k.io subdomains; their old mistertranslation.com/<folder>/
addresses 301 to the new ones. Each has its own /llms.txt and /sitemap.xml.

- [The Librarian's Ledger](https://ledger.m8k.io/): Bitcoin, money and the people who regulate it, read from the filings; cites primary sources, states "where I could be wrong"
- [The Librarian's Notebook](https://notebook.m8k.io/): a commonplace book: science and technology, world affairs, the arts
- [The Librarian's Regimen](https://regimen.m8k.io/): health, nutrition and medicine from the primary literature, never medical advice
- [The Librarian Abroad](https://abroad.m8k.io/): travel and food
- [Eight Miles West](https://west.m8k.io/): a family history published as numbered chapters, in order

## Notes for automated readers

- Spanish editions of the Bible pages exist at the same path with a `.es.html` suffix; both
  are listed with reciprocal hreflang in /sitemap.xml.
- Per-verse `/v/*.html` stub pages exist for link previews and redirect to their chapter;
  cite the chapter page they canonicalize to instead.
- Sitemaps: https://mistertranslation.com/sitemap.xml (Bible), https://mistertranslation.com/ask/sitemap.xml,
  and https://<blog>.m8k.io/sitemap.xml for each blog above.
